_note: Monitored sources (October 2026). Guide sources are added automatically from each guide's '## Sources' section by build.js; the entries here add sources that are not in a guide, and the rules set how each is checked. mode: auto (checked daily), manual (an automated check is not permitted or not possible: shown as 'checked by hand'), not_authorised (a supervisor directory: off until the body gives written permission; see docs/source-monitoring/permissions.md). Nothing here is personal data.
